name: henchman
description: Delegate only well-fitted chores to Claude Code backed by MiniMax, with task gating, first-use Headroom installation, token compression, project-isolated persistent worker memory, bounded parallelism, and mandatory Codex verification.

interface.shortDescription: A guarded MiniMax worker pool with auto-installed compression and project memory.
interface.longDescription: Henchman is a Codex plugin that first assesses task fit, then delegates only low-risk research, documentation, tests, read-only review, and narrowly scoped mechanical implementation to Claude Code CLI through MiniMax. On first use, it automatically installs a pinned Headroom runtime into its own user-level virtual environment, then uses the local proxy to reduce repeated context and give workers persistent project-isolated memory without changing global Claude settings. It enforces a five-minute default budget, bounded parallel workers, progress events, secret-free statistics, and pending-Codex review status. Codex keeps ownership of architecture, unfamiliar APIs, platform integration, security, deployment, and final verification.
defaultPrompt: Use Henchman for safe MiniMax coding chores
Check whether this task is suitable for MiniMax
Check Headroom compression and project memory
Run these independent chores in parallel
